methods: Read exact local BSP/entity/model-zero draw-surface and compiled brush-plane evidence, preserving source hashes and revision identities.
QL draw-surface sections and sampled patches describe projected form only. No QL player hull or native path is certified.

Q2 auh2dm1 local routes use exact stored-plane convex solids, zero collision epsilon, all589 model-zero player blockers,32x32x56 standing hull, full endpoint support-footprint membership, and continuous swept clearance.
Q2 support brush286 is convex and horizontal at feetZ-128; endpoint full-footprint containment proves continuous flat contact along the six checked segments.
Liquid brush bounds use exact plane intersections; a brush extent is not a measured swimming depth or exit proof.
Use source-authored item origins and direct target relations. Do not interpret mode filters, infer runtime settled origins, or turn trigger-box centers into contact points.
Inspect analytical plans and supplied package artwork; no native game, input automation, OS screenshot, asset transfer or geometry reuse.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: Partial upper paths create meaningful shared encounters while retaining distinct lower circulation.
reusable_patterns.contract: Support and sweep the whole usable walkway/underpass; give each upper route a destination and cost.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Remove only one upper path; compare route choice and resource control.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: An atrium/court can organize cross-level visibility and separate routes within a compact footprint.
reusable_patterns.contract: Label its intended view/approach separation; do not count it as dead exterior by projection alone.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Fill only one selected void; compare visibility/control and movement.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: Joined rear and separated arms produce different approaches around an inset.
reusable_patterns.contract: Author true concave room topology as convex pieces; certify ordinary turns and each arm.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Fill only the inset; keep items and doorways fixed.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: An obstacle with unequal supported bypasses can create local pursuit/escape decisions.
reusable_patterns.contract: Validate both sides with hull and support; treat optional top access separately.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Remove only this barrier; measure route selection and exposure.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: A liquid lane adds a state/sound/commitment choice if exits and a dry alternative are explicit.
reusable_patterns.contract: Bind actual contents/depth to support and Q2 immersion state; prove exits separately.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Drain only the lane while retaining its bed and all other geometry.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: A shortcut trades path cost for an exposed, oriented arrival and lost momentum under stock Q2.
reusable_patterns.contract: Ordinary graph still works when link disabled; validate real arrival/occupancy/escape.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Disable only the teleporter; compare actual journey and post-arrival outcomes.

reusable_patterns.hypothesis: Nearby volumes with selective floor overlap can shorten useful circulation without removing courts or tactical separation.
reusable_patterns.contract: Report rendered-surface coverage separately from authored envelope use and certified reachable floor area.
reusable_patterns.ablation: Shorten only one exterior connector while preserving doorway angles and resources.
